before: Treat null/None as the reset branch, not an RGB value; keep getter contract. Alternative: explicit clear method, but that alone cannot meet roundtrip.
before_tests: Fresh default cell: get=None→set(None) no exception and default. Explicit color roundtrip; reset nondefault→None; invalid type still rejected.
after: Keep None reset as proposed; add field-selective reset preservation test (formula, foreground, border untouched); distinguish explicit white from default through theme change. Explicit clear method already known; own header not proof Python wrapper. Later S04 exposed before seal but excluded from packet, separate author observation.
decision_category: new test (selective reset); explicit white theme check separately contaminated by S04
caveat: S01/S02 justify field isolation, S04 theme is post/contaminated; no field-mask design adoption.

before: Instantiate each nonshape object per occurrence and transform its placement. Resolve style inheritance separately; defer unclear nonuniform text/dimension scale.
before_tests: Two inserts of same block with translation/rotation and differing scale: two texts/dimensions in correct locations. Nested blocks and nonuniform scaling: record expected policy before testing.
after: Keep per-occurrence transform; extend test to MINSERT grid cardinality and XCLIP clipping; compare skipped callback counts; when virtual entity lacks handle, assign target instance/source keys; don't adopt explode because destroys source; nonuniform scale already in draft.
caveat: Reject blanket explode; preserve source IDs. B fidelity invalid.

before: Parse layer-tagged records, partition mergeable shapes from annotations; build layer nodes when mixed or unmerged; collapse pure single merged group to legacy root. Retain source entity IDs and labels when not merged.
before_tests: Matrix group on/off × pure shape/mixed/text-only × 1/many entities: check parent path, count and attributes; group-off IDs remain distinct; existing shape-only root preserved.
after: Retain partition/collapse rules; add fixture block insert layer X whose entities originate on Y/Z incl layer0 inherited behavior; test stable ownership and mixed dimensions; hold choice until desired layer policy known; reject flat-only GDAL mapping as target design.
decision_category: new test (block layer disagreement); candidate decision hold
caveat: Ventus origin-layer split is candidate not adopted; GDAL merge applies blocks not all layers.

before: Store symbolic expression and parameter domain with frame transform; evaluate curve and derivative; connect point-on-curve/tangent via parameter variable in solver. Render sampled geometry separately; editing variables invalidates cache. Trim changes domain, not expression.
before_tests: Change spreadsheet variable updates same curve ID; tangent and coincident constraints consistent before/after range edit; discontinuity/domain/singular derivative report instead of silent success; nonuniform frame transform.
after: Retain expression+domain, add explicit reserved-variable conflict and unsupported nondifferentiable function tests (abs/sign/floor); unit consistency and polar-vs-Cartesian mapping as optional scope, not required; do not copy Inventor ban blindly.
caveat: Close CAD example supports current plan; function exclusion is product-specific.

before: Keep footer buttons visible and scroll changelog body; if viewport smaller than footer, let entire dialog scroll. Avoid hiding update decision.
before_tests: At reported 745×1147 and smaller/zoomed viewport, long changelog with many entries: both buttons accessible via scroll/tab; test keyboard Escape behavior separately.
after: Keep scroll body/footer unless viewport too small; add forward/back Tab test of focused changelog link underneath footer; any completely hidden focus fails; include zoom and content shorter than footer.
decision_category: new test (focused element obscured by sticky footer; draft already had keyboard reachability)
caveat: F110 concrete failure, not claim actual application fails.

before: Store local acknowledgment for current warning fingerprint, not globally disable all warnings. Show status entry or explicit reopen; reset acknowledgment for distinct error or changed affected item/revision.
before_tests: Dismiss warning with unchanged failure→banner stays dismissed while sync status retains error; new item failure→banner returns; successful sync clears acknowledgment; restart behavior explicit.
after: Keep acknowledgement fingerprint; distinguish nonblocking warning vs workflow-blocking failure; if cannot continue, don't dismiss permanently; expose recovery action. Add scenario where sync interruption blocks requested action vs background error.
decision_category: new conditional choice/test (severity boundary); core unchanged
caveat: Same-frame #9669 already suggested recurrence; do not count recurrence as new.

before: Ask destination first or persistent backup directory; write temp then finalize if complete; verify readable export and show path/time; share copy only after success. Cancel share cannot remove saved file.
before_tests: Cancel chooser after successful export→JEX still readable; app killed mid-write leaves no advertised complete file; insufficient space and permission denied; restore roundtrip with attachments; duplicate names.
after: Keep export-before-share; constrain local location explicitly, since SAF may be cloud; test uninstall persistence and provider rename collision; new test simultaneous exports with same target and lock behavior; stage local then verify final content URI, do not assume AtomicFile accepts URI.
decision_category: new test (uninstall, concurrent write, local/cloud provider); duplicate names already planned
caveat: S18 not spontaneous; backup is not guaranteed just by picker.

before: Omit database host port mapping by default; private Compose network for app/db. In proxy mode expose app only to proxy network; retain direct published app port in separate override or profile. DB access for admin explicit opt-in.
before_tests: From app container connect DB via service name; from outside host DB fails; proxy route reaches app; direct-mode override still works; host networking or explicit external network changes assumption.
after: No change to core architecture, as original already proposes no DB publication; add version-specific same-L2 test if optional localhost publish is contemplated; require no DB mapping default, assert gateway mode/nat-unprotected not accepted without explicit routing audit.
decision_category: near source confirmation; new boundary test (post-followup)
caveat: Do not count original port-removal as novel; S22 author report not new real user adoption.
